review_description: The quoting process went very smoothly and very quick under 2 hrs from when first contactedRenewable Energy organised every thing from start to finish, They even downloaded the smart app to my phone for meVery punctual with their timing and a very neat installation couldn't be any more happier with them.Highly recommend this company.
My solar panels were installed 2012 and now its not working, and I can't contact Cable Logic anymore

I was getting quotes for a 1.5kW system from various companies. What renewable logic failed to say was it is a 1.05?kW system when they quoted for comparison, which is a huge difference. Prices were the same as other companies for larger 1.5 system. Feeling very stupid to have been duped so easily. System installed 2009. Is currently not working. Doing the math to see whether worth paying an electrician to get it fixed so added up saving. Unit saves on average $19.35 per 61 Day billing cycle. That is a total of $116.10 per year. So far then for 6 years we ha e saved $696.66. Unit cost $2500. It will take us 21 years and 6 months to recoup installation costs before it starts paying for itself. That is if it was working, and the cost to fix will probably be more than the $696.66 saved so far. What a waste of money.

I have not been getting any energy credit for 3 years. I was asked to get on a ladder and take photos of my roof. so the sale rep could work out how many panels he could fit on my roof. When the quote arrived, there was no name /address or phone contact on it. ( which is illegal in WA) Could not fault the Installation, was very well done. I have only just found out that I have not been getting any credit for the power i have been producing. They did not give me any paperwork to submit to Synergy. I was told by the Current manager that it would have been in the pack. I have since looked at all the paperwork in the pack and the info sheet included has no mention of a RED sheet for synergy. They do not want to help at all with the credit i have lost. Now I have to try and get Synergy to recognize that i have a system on my roof.

Was told it would be installed 3 weeks after it had approval from Synergy. Two months after their approval I still hadn't heard anything and had to ring twice and let them know how unhappy I was. Then things got moving and was installed in 2 weeks. I do know that there was sickness involved and staff problems but felt that they need to care more about keeping customers informed. The installers were prompt and efficient and friendly.

A very complicated experience to go through because of the large amount of systems available on the market with a very wide price range associated with them. I was happy with Renewable Logic in all aspects and hopefully I've purchased a system that will last and help reduce my power costs.
Be very careful, do your homework, it's your money you are losing if the cheapy product fails after a few years.

I cannot rate "Value for Money" . It isn't as if I regularly buy Solar Energy systems. I was informed I had paid too much for it by a competitor but other quotes and internet research shows the price I paid was average for the system.The company I used were reliable - they kept me informed, they came when they said they would and the job was completed in the time frame I was given. The installers were polite, neatly dressed, kept the work area neat and, given how quickly they completed the install, efficient.My only concern was the company didn't give me sufficient notice regarding payment. The company expects money 48 hours prior to install. It was a bare 48 hours when they informed me of install date. If there had been a delay in the transfer - and banks are notorious for that - it may not have been a good situation. That was the only hiccup in the whole deal.

All three suppliers were great. In the end, after doing my own research into the systems that were presented, I went for the system that Cablelogic suggested. Installation and the customer service was great. I am really happy with my system.

I object to being subject to a buying practice that requires one to fully pay for the system (Confirmed payment required) prior to providing an installation date. This company would not budge on these terms - only action available is to cancel the installation and not pay.The inverter installed failed on testing at site.  I think this is indicative of some failings in their operating systems.

Was the only Supplier to actually bother to:1) Come and view the site2) Explain the differences in the Components as per quality Etc.3)Advise as to how Solar actually works and how to gain the most benefit from it.The only "complaint" I have is that there was no follow up after installation, to check that all was OK.

Renewable Logic were on time, tidy and efficient with installation. Even after hours of research, customers don't know which is a better quality product.The after sales service is very important and you only truly find out if this exists when something goes wrong - which you don't expect and hope never does!! One has to initially go with trust that you are receiving the best quality product from a trustworthy dealer for the best price. Finding a recommended dealer who has no negative customer feedback is the way to go. But visiting the Solarquotes website helped tremendously understanding solar power panels!Difficult to comment on financial satisfaction without having received first bill and at this early stage to compare energy savings. With the low grid rebate rate it boils down to lifestyle. Understanding that if no-one's home during the day using the generated solar power, then the saving is minimal until the weekend higher power usage.

The installers were excellent and the salesman good. However none of the salesmen consulted warned me about the mismatch between the daytime production of electricity in the winter months and mainly night-time usage, resulting in a longer payback period in States such as WA where the value of electricity exported is much lower at 8.4c/kwh than the cost of electricity at 25c/kwh.

As we are located in North West it was all done over the phone and the service was very good, prompt and they followed up well.Even though Western power & synergy were difficult to deal with this company was used to dealing with them and assisted us to get things done on time.
The installation was carried out only 3 days ago. Hopefully I have chosen wisely, but performance of the installed system remains to be seen.

We found our salesman Rob Howell to be informative; explaining the system to us in layman's terms which we appreciated.Rob was on the ball, followed through at all times. We would recommend him to others. His installers were young chaps and we found them to be very polite, approachable and tidy in their work area.We are at this time more than happy. Hopefully we will be even more so when we receive our next aurora bill.
Not a lot of feed back, seemed like they weren't really interested. (Their HQ is in West Australia, I am in Tasmania --too bad) not real happy with customer relations.

Renewable Logic of Perth were very believable from the start to finish. Presented all the information and worked out the system taking into consideration our choices and ideas. Communication was very good and prepared to negotiate price. Over all a very stress free exercise.

Rob rang the next day and arrived on time and went through past bills and worked out the system we needed. They thoroughly explained how every thing worked the installers came and installed on the due date and we would highly recommend this company.

Renewable Logic were the first company who were prepared to come out to my property and do a full needs analysis.Phil did an excellent job at explaining pro's & con's. Also they provide an interest free pay off system.The contractors used for the installation were very professional, imformative as well as clean and efficient

I did extensive research via this website and even went to the extent of going about our estate asking questions. In the end, we chose Renewable Logic because of good reviews they have on SolarQoutes and on Whirlpool and also an excellent salesperson by the name of Lemy who came across very honest and not pushy. They were quickest to reply as well. Price wise their quote was about par with the other quotes I ended up getting through SolarQuotes.The installation was done promptly and professionally. The system is producing about 9-10 kWh/day which is decent for a 1.5 kW system. About 6-7 kWh on a cloudy day.

The salesman told me the panels were tier 1 being from a tier 1 factory. I was told to look on the net to see a list of panels by another person regarding tiers, on the list the panels I were getting came in at tier 2. I put this to my supplier. He told me they are made in a t 1 factory so they are tier 1. I don't know who to believe, but in the whole scheme of things its done now. I can only hope for a good run out of it. Its very much like car yards, $1500 system. Won't do much, but our $5000 system is what you need and they're probably right.

I bought the one from Renewable Logic. It was the most expensive, but it was the only quote I trusted.Their sales rep came around and made an onsite inspection - the others didn't.So far, the daily power generation has matched their estimate, but it is somewhat early days.

Good informative sales pitch, none of this high pressure, irrelevant over powering sales talk.Quotes were a variety of systems from cheap to more expensive.I did ask for German Panels and a top range German Converter and they delivered and installed when promised.Could not fault the installation team and received a lot of useful information from them as well.
Renewable Logic were the only company to supply a quote within a reasonable time and are a local company to deal with.
We went with Renewable Logic because they delivered the quote and explained face to face how things worked. Prior to that, there was just too much information to comprehend from the internet sites.

Renewable logic were the only people tocome to our house to give a quote and explain how the panels would benefit us. They were $100.00 dearer than the nearest quote but because they gave such good customer service we chose to go with them.My father in-law had also got prices to get panels installed, we gave him the number to contact renewable logic energy and after getting a quote from them he also decided to go with them.Thank you for the contacts you gave us.For me personally it's not just about the money, but also the service.Thank you.

Renewable Logic gave an on site written quote. This allowed us to discuss position of the panels as well as the inverter and isolators. Also, the size of the system was 7 panels at 260 watts each. Total therefore is 1820 watts with a 2 kW inverter.
The only one that supplied technical details of the panels and the inverter. Did not bother me with sales pitch. I am looking forward to the installation.
Hi Finn,A bit early to say how effective the system is but only one of the 3 companies supplied attended (Renewable) and more than happy with their sales rep and installation.Regards!

Not the cheapest in the market but my preference was to go with a larger reputable company. The installers, who are employees of the company, were professional and took great pride in their work. Very pleased with the outcome. Great job guys!

Renewable Logic were accessible, happy to explain things, delivered within time frames given and even followed up after install to make sure we were happy.  They also gave us several options to choose from in terms of quality, and weren't pushy.  We had a tight budget, but didn't necessarily want the cheapest option, as we want our sytem to last 25 years.   My only comment would be for the other companies that quoted us - with hindsight, we might have been able to buy a comparable system a little cheaper from somewhere else, but the other companies initially only quoted us for one brand of panels and inverter, and I didn't realise that they could also provide other brands as well if requested.  Overall, would happily use Renewable Logic again.

I paid $2700 for a 1.56kw system using 6 Yingli panels and a 1500 Growatt inverter.  These are good quality Chinese products.  Yingli are just breaking into the market here so there was $1000 off the normal price.  I had my panels placed on my south facing roof but mounted on tilted frames facing north.  I have a lot of trees and this was the best position with least shade.  I paid extra for the frames but got them for half price.  I couldn't praise Dermy the consultant too highly!  He was prepared to spend time and was so helpful without trying to pressure me in any way and explained everything clearly and simply.  He also gave me important information that I didn't get anywhere-else (I actually contacted 5 or 6 different companies) for example about the Australian testing facility, Desert Knowledge Australia and the significance of panels being tested for Australian conditions. A lot of performance data is based on overseas testing where conditions may be very different.  He also left me with well presented written material including a fact sheet of the 16 steps towards switching to solar power with expected time frames.  Plus he's a very nice and funny guy!

The sales person from Renewable Logic was very happy to sell me the panels but when it came time to finish the deal I found him very unhelpful, he didn't reply to my phone calls, and a very long delay in emailing me for an answer.Then tells me he can't fit me in and the price will go up. Very unprofessional very unhappy

Hi FinnAs you know, only one supplier responded to your initial request for quotes.  I went with this company because they got back to me within half an hour of your request.  All the way through the process I have been kept informed and was even able to renegotiate the price when it went up rather significantly after I'd been given the initial quote.  The system was only installed this afternoon but all the installers (about eight of them!!!!) were very professional and were happy to explain what they were doing.Very pleased with the service.

I was required to have Foxtel antenna moved (which proved to be unecessary) and my TV  antenna due to a shadowing effect on the panels. To be fair the Company then offered to refund the cost. Unfortunately the system failed on the 28th of December (remains on stand by & therefore no current being produced). Due to the Christmas Break I have had to wait for the Company to recommence business which I am hoping will be tomorrow. If you like, wait until things have been attended to and I will give a further report. Prior to stopping the system was working well .Jim Willetton W.A.
Very Professional organisation that also gave advice on how to reduce and make better use of electrical power. They were very friendly and quickly to respond to any questions.

Of the 3 quotes sought, one was exceptionally high but offered considerable discounts for such minor considerations such as displaying a sign naming the company. this raised suspicions about their veracity.Further discounts were offered for immediate sign up and that these would not be available tomorrow.This put me off immediately.Company 2 did not turn up or even phone at the appointed time.Company 3 was half the price of company 1 and that included a larger capacity inverter, still not cheap but at $3900, better than $7200.

Had trouble getting Synergy to change the meter, It took 1 application from Renewable Logic which bounced back to me because it wasn't filled out correctly and 3 from me as two disappeared into the ether.I listed Customer Service as poor because we have had 3 installation dates up to now and we still have not had the install done 2 months after paying the deposit.
panel_brand: Do not know what they were replaced with (Other)

review_description: The info and advice I got off the solar quotes web site helped me to understand the systems on offer and enabled me to ask the right questions of the rep from Renewable Logic. I found him to be veryknowledgable on the products and it gave me confidence to go ahead with their quote.
For a 4kw system in and out in 6 hours. Made provision to upgrade to 5kw next year.
sorry i had waited,as rebate decreased and I would suggest to anyone wanting to install one to do it now.

Unfortunately the sales figures quoted on savings do not match the actual savings on the system. The installation happened over 3 separate days due to supplier not having equipment available on the day (ie) panels and cabling installed one day, converter on another day and finally current cost meter installed on yet another day. This was very inconvenient from a customer perspective.Advice regarding shading also varied. If I had been provided with more accurate information at the time of sale I may have chosen a larger system to further offset my home running costs.

Renewable logic sent out a sales person who spent time explaining about the system and its use, the different options for us we have not had the system installed yet but have started the process.They were the only ones to call back and come out the other person made an appointment and did not show(this was an extra provider provided by solar quotes as was close but not on their list).We appreciated the time spent and they also continued to email ideas on saving power and tips- we rang the sales man to give him the sale to show we were impressed with his help.Would refer others to both solar quotes and Renewable logic in the futureThanks for the service Finn
It is extremely helpful if you know somethng about solar panels etc before you talk to these companies as sometimes the jargon can confuse you.

The whole process went smoothly. The installers did a thorough job and Damien returned my calls promptly. I chose RL for the quality of the panels and they ticked all the quality assurance boxes. I'll recommend them to anyone who's looking at installing solar pv's!

I felt for the dollars that we payed, the inverter could have been set up for us, i.e the correct time and Australian dollars not Euro.  The person who signed off at our home after the installation could have been better informed about our product i.e the Aurora Inverter.It was only installed yesterday so it was difficult to properly gauge what we think of it.

Added expenses involved, our long driveway means a long feed in and needs to be upgraded, Italian Auroa inverter has caused a few issues - still not sorted.Your website is very informative and I have recommended it to others to view.

We decided to go for the best overall quote taking into account the anticipated customer service.  It's hard to anticipate follow-up customer service when quotes are just given via telephone.  When a Service Rep visits the home to quote, checks out the property as well as the power meter and the probable location for the inverter, this indicates that that company is getting all the information required to be able to quote effectively.When the installers arrived right on the pre-arranged time of 0830, that was another indication that all would go well.We believe we got a good deal and hopefully there won't be any need for "customer service" in the near future, but if there is, we also feel that we'll get good service.A couple of telephone calls to the office were answered promptly and a message left for a callback on one occasion, was initiated.  The callback was provided within an hour or so.  Fantastic Customer Service, thanks.

I found all of the companies you recommended to be very professional and knowledgeable.  They all provided similar advice and discussed clearly the various options.They did not promise what could not be delivered which other companies had.The installation was well done and even when they encountered some problems they discussed with me what they would need to do before they commenced it.
They were very efficient from quote through to installation.Quality product and very good fitting.
We were very happy with the whole process.

We only have one negative in the whole process!! The installers were very late on the day, and never finished to well after dark. As we are very new to this system and the manual doesn't explain the read out all that well we are unable to determine just how well we are going for the moment. (Despite the rain) Maybe installing in the daylight would be a good idea. The guys doing the installation were all very professional and courteous.

Renewable Logic's sales person was very knowledgeable and advised us the system which suited most our needs and not the most expensive one. The communication with the company office was great and we have been well informed of the progress during the whole process. We waited around 7 weeks until the system was installed. The installation went smoothly, the workmanship was neat and tidy. We can only recommend Renewable Logic.

From quote to installation the service was great. Went with company that's large, been around for ages and will still be around after all the rebates. They use Q panels which test out at the top of the range and have a high output meaning less roof space used. They even got good feedback from other companies. All in all an enjoyable experience.

We chose Renewable Logic for the purchase and fit of our Solar Converter and Panels because the salesperson sat with us and explained the whole process in an easy to understand way.The salesperson did not try to pressure sell us more than what was required and we received excellent service with the fitting of the system and also the company kept us informed via email as the process progressed.I would recommend Renewable Logic to others.
Renewable Logic gave us facts encouraged us not to overspend and put in a system that we did not need. The follow up service of keeping us informed on how our order was progressing has been great.
I still don't think any of the solar companies were able to provide details of how the electricity gets fed back to the grid.

If I had one complaint it would be the fact that the guys that installed our system broke 6 roof tiles and whilst they replaced them with some spare's that I had, I really didn't mind them using them but I would have preferred it if they had told me what they had done so I could have replaced them, I always like to have a few spares on hand for emergencies.

The system was only installed two weeks ago but there have been no teething problems. The sales person was very thorough in explaining things and happily tolerated our incessant questions and going back over things. We felt he was honest and upfront about the cost which is not the cheapest around but our motto is "you get what you pay for" and we feel confident that the product is of good quality. But should a problem arise in the future, the company is reputable and will happily resolve it for us. The installation guys were punctual, efficient and tidy.

Salesman very informative and was realistic in what system is best for us.  As soon as everything was put in place and signed, they gave us an install date.  They were there on the day and before the agreed time.  Very efficient and friendly.
Only just installed but looks OK on the roof, seems to work. Initial reaction is, I am pleased but time will tell because not much sunshine in Perth at the present.

The sales rep was informative and gave us advice on what's required and how best to go about. We are targeting installation for around June after renovations are complete. Have also taken the solar water system from them. We will be able to judge better their customer service after the installation is complete and also how satisfied we are with the system - after all the sales pitch.
The Sales person wasn't pushy and knew what he was talking about. When I put different matters to him he had the answers.

We were kept up to date during the process. On installation day the workers arrived at the stated time and got the job underway. It was completed within the projected time frame. Everything was there, and everything worked perfectly. No broken tiles on the roof and no rubbish left behind. Highly recommended.

Very willing to answer questions and I had a lot. Salesperson very knowledgeable, also explained whole process so we knew what to expect and when. Installation was very professional, team arrived on time (15 minutes early really). When finished, installer explained operation of inverter. From time of quote to installation was 6 weeks. Couldn't be happier.

Tony the sales rep was very knowledgeable and informative and was not pushy. He let the system sell itself really. However, the fact that they are local and have been around for a while, reputable company and guarantee and fix their own work made it an easier choice. I had a cheaper quote but wasn't sure about the people. I have called Tony a couple of times about it also and he had an answer every time and always called back. Would recommend them for sure.

From the beginning to the end the sales person Dermy and the installer were very helpful. When they had to cancel the first installation  date they let us know in plenty of time. When they came to install the item they were on time.  Took time to explain what they were doing. Very good service. And I found Finn`s information very useful.

I went with Renewable Logic for price and quality of products and the warranty on the inverter and they use there own people to install the systems.The sales person whilst very informative stated that they only use thier own personnel to install the systems, as others use subcontractors when on the day they actually sent subcontractors to install the system which was a tad different to what I was told, though they where very tidy and informed me that they get this comment mentioned to them all the time when installing systems for for RL.I am currently producing around 14 kw per day which around half our daily consumption so are happy with that being this time of the year.

There was a mix up with one of the parts (wasn't with the install gear) so the electrician had to come back later, but the company didn't rebook as they thought I was on holiday (no idea where they got that from???). I had to call the office to book a time for the electrician to finish the install.Also, in the first letter sent out, they forgot to take off the discount from the purchase price that we had negotiated with the salesperson.

Hi Finn,Renewable Logic were the only company to get in touch with me of the 3 you sent me, and I  phone a couple of other suppliers and they were much the same price. So I went with renewable Logic..  I ended up getting 12 Q-PEAK BLACK 250 PANELSand GROWATT SUNGOLD INVERTER 3000L . I would have liked to get a better inverter but thatwould have cost more.  It's great to see that meter spin backwards.I would be interested in your opinion of my system.Many thanks.

Firstly,thank you Finn for all the information, it helped a lot.Of the 3 Quotes you supplied only Renewable Logic contacted us, but we got at least 4 others through Newspaper and TV ads.Renewable have been fantastic from Day 1. The rep was great not pushy at all. We were told of our installation date and time, and they were true to their word. On time and all up and running in less than 3 hrs. Highly recommended.
Sales person had good product knowledge, explained everything very well, and installation was excellent.
I have a hole came through in my study wall from the outside where the inverters are installed in my carport. Waiting for customer service to get back in touch with me.

Alan from Renewable Logic was fantastic and spent a lot of time explaining how the system worked and the quality of the panels. He was also not 'pushy' and allowed me time to obtain other quotes before contacting me. Although not the cheapest price overall for me it was the standard of the service that was the winning factor. Thanks to Alan and everyone at Renewable Logic.

There was a vast difference between the professionalism of the various solar companies, as well as the techniques they used to try to get our business. Tony Ryan from Renewable Logic was professional, honest, reliable and a pleasure to deal with.We also used the services of the Perth Solar City staff to get a power audit done on our house. That informed us about the size of the system we needed as well as other ways we could reduce energy consumption and power costs.

I did not receive a quote from one of the suppliers, Silic Energy. Infinite were also very good, on price and quality of components, and would have probably got the business but they did not send out a salesperson to explain the systems, etc.
I would have liked some proper instruction on how to program the inverter properly.

The installers erected scaffolding (2 storey house) then realised they couldn't install from the scaffolding position - which is OK but no one bothered to let us know there was a problem - scaffolding went up, then 3 days later it came down - no panels - we had to chase up the company to find out what the hell was going on. Panels were eventually installed almost 2 weeks later than original installation date - the system seems to be working OK but we have had no contact with the company since the installers left about 2 weeks ago. We actually paid $800 for scaffolding, which turned out not to be unnecessary as they got to the roof via an alternative route - no scaffolding needed. No suggestion of a refund even though they botched the job! Poor customer service in a cut throat industry -  even though the sales pitch was about customer service - that's one of the reasons we chose this company - they were the most expensive, but promised good customer service. And the irony is that it doesn't cost much to contact the clients and let them know what's going on - all we wanted was information, but had to chase the company! A phone call or two from them would have made all the difference! Australian companies just don't get it.

From go to wo the service was excellent. The system installed exceeded my expectations and the output is very good. The installers and service electrician went to a lot of trouble to fully explain what I needed to know and answered any question I had. I would fully recommend these people to anyone wishing to have a system installed.

Alan Rohan, the sales guy who visited us was very knowledgeable and straight talking. He advised us what to look for and where to look plus gave us a couple of options. He wasn't "Pushy" but very helpful. I would recommend him and Renewable Logic to others looking to purchase a solar system. We felt very comfortable and trusting of the company. The installers were terrific and very courteous and the followup from Renewable Logic was pleasant and customer orientated.

I have 2 units 1 facing north  1 facing west due to roof space on 1 & shade factor on the otherthe 7 QCells needed to be split which Renewable Logic did on the first unit but not on the one with the shade factor to their credit after I explained the problem they did come back & split the cells & moved them higher on the roof. They installed a Growatt Sungold 1.5kw Inverter which is performing wellat present so for the money I am happy with both systems I had 7 quotes in all and value for moneyRenewable Logic was the best.Apart from giving me incorrect installation times & installing the cells incorrectly I would recommend them. It would help to have the installers send a google picture of the roof plan showing cell arrangement on the roof.

I went with renewable logic for a couple of reasons:1. The rep was really helpful and not pushy.2. They were the only company that actually got back to me within a reasonable time.3. The installers were great guys and just on with the job at hand without any fuss.4. The price was comparable to others as I checked before I went ahead with it.5. I would recommend these guys to anyone.As for the other companies they did eventually contact me (after a little prompting) and I told them I had already had someone doing it.

The girls and guys at Renewable Logic were good from start to finish. We applied in June 2011, during the WA rush. Renewable are not a pushy bunch, but friendly - kept us informed during every stage of the process. The installation was done right on target, the boys were very polite, CLEANED up well after themselves (thanks!), and very helpful. After-sales service so far has been great. I would highly recommend them to anyone.
Installation was well ahead of scheduled time frame, good service all around, Thanks girls and guys, one happy chap!

The salesman that came out left the company without our knowledge. He didn't put in our details to their system before he left and we had a signed contract. This meant we weren't on their list for installation. Luckily I had a feeling something was wrong when no deduction went off our credit card after several weeks so I called and had the job registered. At first the sales manager, Tony Ryan, tried to say we would have to pay more for the system (& significantly more) but I told him we had a signed contract. After a few minutes of heated discussion he agreed to honour the contract and we were back on track. Tony came out the next day and took all the measurements and installation details himself. The installation is due in late July/Early August and hopefully now it goes smoothly.
The company Renewable Logic WA were not too quick to take my deposit.  They appear to have waited until they started (planning/design) work before debiting the credit card.  This was a nice touch.
These guys are well organized and turned up on time. The salesman was knowledgeable. The phone assistance was good and consistence so far.

Sales person knew a lot about the system he was selling. Took the time to explain my options and was very friendly. Installation guys were fantastic too, they were friendly and informed me what they were about to do. They even cleaned up before they left so you wouldn't even know they had been.

Our system has not been installed yet, as we are still waiting for the go ahead from Synergy (4 weeks and counting)We have been told by the supplier that they will honour the installation in due time to receive the current rebate. Can't say much else as nothing else has happened. Thanks for the independent info, it was invaluable, as I knew nothing about solar power when I started. Your information gave me a grounding before I approached the companies, so that I had some idea of what to ask & understood what they were talking about.
Your quotes helped significantly.  It's a pretty tough market and the amount of information is overwhelming at times and often hair-splitting comparisons.
Renewablelogic turned out to be part of a larger company that had been around for many years...this made me feel a bit more secure.
your website made it easy to get the knowlege and quotes i needed  thank you

Communication and organisational abilities absolutely dreadful. Took ages to arrange a suitable installation date. They kept leaving me messages to contact them but when I phoned them there was never anyone available to help, they also had my contact details for work, home mobile and email. This went on for about 3 weeks. I eventually emailed them and threatened to cancel the contract and ask for a refund of deposit, I had a phone call within 10 minutes and an installation date I asked for a different date same week and they agreed straight away.I received a letter from them saying the installation team would arrive by 07.30, due to this I got up at 06.30 so I could have breakfast and get ready for them also in case they were a bit early. 09.10 no one had arrived. I phoned them and spoke to Andrew installation manager and told him the problem, I thought maybe they had had an installation in York the day before so that is why they were to start early, he said that I had received a standard letter and that start time was in the metro area.Again I had to complain, and suggested that they take more time researching their customers and ensure that they get a more personal service which takes into account their customers locations and send out letters that are appropriate to the customers particular needs.
